about_the_game:
Generative AI Character Creation × Auto-Battle RPG

Collect the 'Adventure Logs' and mend the crumbling world—

Create heroes with the AI Goddess 'Lumiela,' send them forth on adventures.
A laid-back yet deep auto-battle RPG!

Summon a Hero Through Conversation with the AI Goddess

You will summon heroes by answering questions posed by the Goddess Lumiela.
Gender? Personality? Hometown? Values?
You can answer freely or choose from options. Imagine a concrete character vision and summon the hero you desire!

Send Your Summoned Hero into an Adventure

Your hero will automatically defeat enemies and advance deeper and deeper into the dungeon.

“Oh no! My hero died during the adventure!”

There’s no time to grieve. Summon the next hero—

The heroes who have fallen before will support the current adventure as 'Spirits'!
Summon heroes again and again, aiming for the deepest part of the dungeon!

Enhance Your Heroes with Gear and Materials

Strengthen your heroes and spirits with items obtained during your adventures!
You can upgrade weapons, armor, and accessories, and also use gathered materials to strengthen your heroes' basic stats.
